# The week in Colombia — Oct 19–23, 2026

**Big picture:** August activity weakened while September inflation remained above 6%. Budget cuts and a budget decree for next year added a fiscal story ahead of the next rate decision.

**1. Activity contracted in August.** DANE's activity index fell 0.04% from a year earlier and 3.11% from July after seasonal adjustment; year-to-date output still grew 2.27%. One weak month does not establish a continuing recession, while inflation above target complicates the policy backdrop. Affected: Businesses, workers and households. [Source](https://www.dane.gov.co/files/operaciones/ISE/bol-ISE-ago2026.pdf).

**2. A spending cut now and next year’s budget by decree.** The spending-cut decree reduces 2026 appropriations by COP 13.81 trillion \(Decreto 1585\), while the next budget decree sets 2027 revenue and spending at COP 634.95 trillion \(Decreto 1599\). Funding for commitments already legally formalized is protected; this is not proof of cash savings. The government cites a failure to reconcile Congress's two budget texts. Affected: Public agencies, contractors and people receiving public services. [Source](https://svrpubindc.imprenta.gov.co/diario?edicion=53.666).

**3. Security-purchase transparency remains disputed.** Three lawmakers asked to shelve the public-order bill over implementation and oversight concerns \(PL 433 Cámara / 296 Senado\). The revised clause removed explicit nonpublication language but kept a reserved-procurement reference. The October 21 session was scheduled, but no certified result or adopted text had been established. Affected: Security agencies, suppliers and people monitoring public spending. [Source](https://svrpubindc.imprenta.gov.co/gacetas/index.xhtml?gaceta=1588).

**Our calls:** No calls or resolutions this week. The historical public record is 4 right-side calls out of 6; the internal record is 2 of 3. None were open by Friday. These small samples do not establish calibration.

**Next week**
- 2026-10-30 — BanRep interest-rate decision. No call had been recorded by Friday.
